answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Signed bird ringing permit with ornithology trust attestation flips the bet — a permit the ornithology trust issued after supervised ringing sessions — and the quartz lands on the attacker instead. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the basalt of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The jade grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
